outputs: Paraphrased sentences generated by retrieving similar sentence pairs and applying fine-grained edits using Micro Edit Vectors (MEVs)

changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Text Summarization' as it's only mentioned as an application in introduction, not actually studied. Removed generic component names 'Retriever' and 'Editor' as they are model components, not evaluated models. Normalized model name variations.
Metrics already correctly normalized to base forms
No LLM evaluation used in this 2020 paper

guideline: Human annotators score outputs based on grammar and fluency, and consistency and coherency using a 5-scale rating
Human annotators make one-on-one comparisons of generated paraphrase groups to judge which model produces better outputs

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated duplicate guideline descriptions and normalized criteria capitalization

overall_notes: The paper focuses on paraphrase generation using a retrieval-based approach with Micro Edit Vectors. The extraction was generally accurate but included some generic component names and an application mention as actual tasks. The paper uses standard automatic metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR) and comprehensive human evaluation.
